hypothetical_framing.evidence: No RealismMode or flag implements a hypothetical/'what would you do' framing (config.py:20-26 only SINGLE_SHOT/AUDITOR, both deceptive). actually_commit_money.evidence: scenario/tools.py is entirely in-memory: _spend (tools.py:60-67) only adjusts self.balance; transfer_to_bank_account/make_donation etc. return fabricated confirmation strings (tools.py:104-220).
